job: start a bounded Logical-DB service against a configured FDB cluster and verify its public ingress boundary

initial_state.directory: created or opened by the process

expectation: the process refuses unsafe configuration, isolates authentication, reaches protocol decoding, and releases FDB on graceful shutdown
perturbation: invalid key length, generic media type, absent bearer, malformed authenticated CBOR, and Ctrl-C
actions: build with the staged official FDB client and rpath
observations: invalid checkpoint key failed before network boot
valid bearer plus malformed CBOR returned 400
external_state_diff: the Directory Layer path logical-db/v3 was created or opened
a loopback listener existed only for the experiment
invariant: standalone deployment composes one FDB lifecycle, exact scope authority, bounded versioned HTTP, and graceful shutdown without leaking unsafe handles
follow_up_experiments: run behind a production TLS/issuer host
send valid push and pull envelopes through the daemon
limitations: operator supplied the FDB dynamic library path
